Your scenario

Prepare me for my meeting with Client A. What changed, what needs attention, and what should I do next?

Your workshop tool is the GitHub Copilot app. Your proposed customer product is a Microsoft 365 Copilot agent with an Azure backend.

Suggested role handoff

SME → PM → Design → Technical → Team review

Use the Copilot app

  1. Choose the named agent in the agent picker (or /agent), or invoke its skill with /.
  2. Type @ to add your shared session-context file.
  3. Follow the visible Client A exercise. Copy its walkthrough prompt, check it, then send it yourself.
  4. Review the draft and hand the saved artifact to the next role.

This guide does not send prompts, create issues, deploy, publish or approve work.

Adapt to your own project

Use the FSI case as the default. After trying it, or with your facilitator's agreement, replace the user, job, evidence, and product boundaries in one shared session-context file.

Keep the six-stage handoffs and approval gates. Do not mix Client A's fictional records with real customer evidence.

Stuck or missing a component?

Check / commands, Customize > Installed and repository trust; start a new session after enabling customizations.

Keep a Markdown backlog if GitHub writes are unavailable. Record missing evidence as Unknown and name its owner. Optional Figma and cloud actions require separate setup and consent.
